howTo.title: How to play
howTo.step1: Every day there is a hero of the day: today it's {{hero}}. The stats come from Ascendant+ ranked matches of the last 7 days.
howTo.typing: Type the name in your language or in English, or type t1, t2, t3 or t4 to list every item of that tier.
howTo.zeroRow: Wrong tier, or nobody bought it first
howTo.step5: You have {{s}} seconds per guess. If time runs out, that guess scores 0.

results.comeBack: A new puzzle starts at your local midnight.

descent.rules: For each tier, name items this hero rarely buys first. The rarer the item, the more souls you earn. Two guesses per tier.

howTo.step2: You go down through 4 layers of the city, one per item tier (T1 to T4). In each layer you get {{n}} guesses.
howTo.step3: Each guess is an item of that tier that this hero RARELY buys first (the first item of that tier they buy in a match).
howTo.step4: Souls depend on the item's position in the rarity ranking of that tier: the rarest scores {{max}}, the most common {{min}}, and points drop fast after the first positions. Tied items score the same. The color shows the band:
howTo.bottomRow: Most common item of the tier
howTo.step6: Souls take you deeper below the city. At the end, compare with the real answers and share your result.
howTo.example: Tip: the obvious core items score little. Think of items that fit the hero badly but that someone, somewhere, still bought first.

ascent.rules: For each tier, name the items this hero buys first most often. The more popular the item, the more souls you earn. Two guesses per tier.

howTo.step2: You start deep under the city and climb through 4 layers, one per item tier (T1 to T4). In each layer you get {{n}} guesses.
howTo.step3: Each guess is an item of that tier that this hero buys first MOST OFTEN (the first item of that tier they buy in a match).
howTo.step4: Souls depend on the item's position in the popularity ranking of that tier: the most picked scores {{max}}, the least picked {{min}}, and points drop fast after the first positions. Tied items score the same. The color shows the band:
howTo.topRow: Most picked first in the tier
howTo.bottomRow: Least picked first in the tier
howTo.bonusRow: Bonus: one of the {{n}} most picked
howTo.step6: Souls carry you up toward the sky. At the end, compare with the real answers and share your result.
howTo.example: Tip: think like a high-rank player. What does this hero rush first in every tier?
